title: Affine descent of the supplied derived projection mate
statement: Use the derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], their canonical K-flat tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] and direct image [def-pc-derived-direct-image] of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. For a morphism f, an adjunction p:Lf^*\dashv Rf_* with counit \epsilon and a natural isomorphism t:Lf^*(-\otimes^L-)\simeq Lf^*(-)\otimes^L Lf^*(-), write \pi_{p,t}(M,L) for the adjunction transpose of t_{M,Rf_*L} followed by 1_{Lf^*M}\otimes\epsilon_L. Fix scheme universe u. Assume that for every commutative ring A of universe u, every quasi-compact quasi-separated Z of universe u, every quasi-compact quasi-separated g:Z\to\operatorname{Spec} A, every p,t as above and every N\in D_{QCoh}(\operatorname{Spec} A), E\in D_{QCoh}(Z), the mate \pi_{p,t}(N,E) is invertible in all choices of the two derived localizations with morphism universe u+1. Then for every quasi-compact quasi-separated X,Y of universe u, every quasi-compact quasi-separated f:X\to Y, all derived localizations in any common morphism universe w, every p,t and M\in D_{QCoh}(Y), L\in D_{QCoh}(X), the mate \pi_{p,t}(M,L) is invertible.

proof.text: Cover Y by affine opens V and identify each with Spec Gamma(V,O). The preimage U is quasi-compact by quasi-compactness of f and quasi-separated by quasi-separatedness of X. Exact open restriction is a localization with fully faithful derived right adjoint; compute its counit on a K-injective resolution, where restriction followed by open direct image returns the restricted complex.

The two tensor-pullback bifunctors factor through restriction to V and U, using the natural restriction comparisons. Descend the supplied t by evaluation on the fully faithful right adjoints and the localization counits. Transport p likewise; the restricted counit formula for its Hom equivalence identifies the restricted projection mate with the descended mate.

Canonical equivalences between choices of localization transport the same K-flat tensor, pullback, direct image and their comparisons to morphism universe u+1. Transport also along V isomorphic to Spec Gamma(V,O). Apply the assumed affine case. Exact restriction preserves quasi-coherent cohomology, so all hypotheses on the restricted objects hold.

Invertibility is detected by cohomology and then by restriction of those sheaves to the affine open cover. Apply the sheaf-module open-cover detection theorem in every cohomological degree. The empty cover for an empty target gives the zero category.
